_meta.artifact: Triple-Barrier Exit Engine — golden-vector parity fixture (Phase 0 contract)
_meta.purpose: The mechanical definition of C++<->Python 'consistent' for the co-evolution principle. TripleBarrierExitManager (C++) and compute_barriers()/scan_lookahead_hybrid() (Python) must BOTH reproduce every expected value below for the given inputs before any barrier decision is considered settled.
_meta.provenance: Expected values hand-derived from the locked C++ dedicated formulas (PositionManagerPatterns.cpp:179-457) + the §5.3 reconciled table + the §5.6 4-step protocol. NOT machine-generated. To be cross-verified: run Python compute_barriers() on the same inputs and confirm identical output; spot-verify against live C++ source. Any divergence is a parity bug to reconcile on the merits, not to paper over.

conventions.prices_are_raw: Barrier prices are RAW (unrounded). Tick-rounding to instrument granularity is applied by the order-submission layer downstream, NOT by the barrier computation. Golden values here are therefore pre-rounding. (If tick-rounding parity ever becomes an issue, add it as its own fixture dimension.)
conventions.effective_atr: effective_atr = atr10 * dof_stop_scale. Dedicated formulas consume the DOF-scaled ATR (call site passes dofScaledAtr).
conventions.regime_stop_width_scale: Phase 1 = 1.0 (identity). The bounded [0.5, 2.0] regime stop-width scale is a Phase 3 calibration; kept as an explicit input at 1.0 so Phase-3 cases are trivially addable.
conventions.reading_B: Composition ruling (2026-07-14, Claude recommended + Gemini CLI code-verified). HIGH patterns (Turtle Soup, Momentum Pinball): target = the raw N-bar structural extreme DIRECTLY (target_r_mult NOT applied). Elder Breakout: 2-bar structural stop + fixed 1.5R target. LOW/defaulted patterns: generic stop = entry - dir*(stop_mult*eff_atr), target = entry + dir*(target_r_mult*risk).
conventions.structural_layer: After the seed (step 1) and regime scale (step 2), the universal 60-min swing fractal is applied LAST (step 4), tightening-only: stop is moved toward entry if the swing is tighter (long: stop=max(stop,swing_low); short: stop=min(stop,swing_high)); target is pulled toward entry if the swing is nearer (long: target=min(target,swing_high); short: target=max(target,swing_low)). Stop and target are refined INDEPENDENTLY — effective R:R may shift from the seed R (see case ITR_FADE_SELL_caps_binding).
conventions.vertical_barrier: max_bars is a pure regime lookup on the TS3 15-minute bar clock. COILED_SPRING=40, GAUSSIAN_STABLE=25 (also default/absent), GAUSSIAN_FRAGILE=15, PARETO_MOMENTUM=12. min(regime_cap, pattern_cap) with all pattern_cap=inf in Phase 1 (so = regime_cap).
conventions.direction_sign: dir = +1 long, -1 short. Elder BUY entry = close if high>prev_high else prev_high+tick.

cases.note: Defaulted short (stop_mult=0.5, target_r_mult=1.0). BOTH structural caps bind: swing_high tightens stop DOWN, swing_low caps target UP. Stop and target refined independently -> effective R:R shifts from seed 1.0 to 1.33 (documented, expected). This is the pattern whose Finding-17 collision would map to HOLY_GRAIL; here it uses agreed defaults instead.
